title: Red Dragon - My Good SidePC
text:
The Red Dragon
Colored with PhotoshopCS

title: T I T A N
text:
I wanted to see what Titan would look like if I coloured him in photoshop and this was the result >.>' I really do hope that it turned out all right >.<

I used only Adobe Photoshop CS2; no Wacom or anything of that sort. I really do hope that it turned out really good... I tried -_-'

I also know that some of the dragon's proportions aren't... well... in proportion >.< Some people caught that and some people didn't; I know I messed up a little with the legs and that I made the tail a bit too thick and the neck a little too long, but at the same time, I still kind of liked how this turned out. 

I don't wish to ask for a critique on this because I know it could be better. I already see many of the problems on it (part of it was how the highlights seem a bit faded >.<'). I think I might want to re-do the colouring a bit, but only when I truly grow pissed off with looking at it.

 Wow! This has over 1,000 favourites! I never thought I would ever get a piece with that many!  Thank you everyone for all of the favourites, it's really appreciated. ^^
